SEBI Bans 221 Entities for 7 Years Over Market Manipulation

India's securities regulator, SEBI, has banned 221 entities from the stock market for seven years. This action targets alleged 'pump and dump' schemes, a form of market manipulation. One individual, identified as Hanif Sheikh, was also fined ₹10 crore.
